title: Is that Airbnb
worth buying?
lines: s1

title: Pull your cash
back out?
lines: s1
Can you pull your cash back out of a rental? That's the BRRRR method. Here's how to check one in under a minute.
s2
Pick BRRRR. Enter the purchase price, the rehab budget, and your closing costs.
s3
Now the key number. The after-repair value, what the home is worth once it's fixed. Add how many months the rehab takes.
s4
Then the refinance. The loan-to-value your lender allows, the new rate, and the closing costs on the new loan.
s5
Add the rent you expect once the work is done, then your purchase loan. Taxes and insurance go in last.
s6
Here's your answer. Cash flow after the refinance. Cash left in the deal. And the equity you created. The less cash left in, the stronger the BRRRR.
s7
Save it, compare it with your other deals, and forge better deals. EquityFoundry. Link in bio.

title: Will this flip
make money?
lines: s1

s5
Here's your answer. Projected profit. Return on investment. And annualized return, so you can compare a flip to a rental.
